limitations: No finite geometric Pfaffian datum P_fin is supplied.
No cosection-reduced skew perfect complex rows are supplied.
No Pfaffian line, square-isomorphism, or orientation rows are supplied.
No finite Pfaffian section rows with support, parity, exponent, and skew-block data are supplied.
No type-II wall chart rows with rank-one normal form and sign computation are supplied.
No Pfaffian-to-automorphic line comparison rows are supplied.
No strict transition or Mittag-Leffler rows for Pfaffian lines and sections are supplied.
No scalar-firewall rows excluding scalar Borcherds products, squared determinants, or OP scalar traces as entries of P_fin are supplied.
